disputes.reason: Two claims in one card; the second overgeneralises: momentum's largest crashes did not all come from policymakers interrupting trends (7 of the 11 largest were in the Great Depression, only 3 in 2008), so the 'largest crashes' wording is not reliably true.

Two claims in one card, and the VOL-versus-BAB significance ranking is specific to one sample and specification (t=4.37 vs 1.89, 1963-2011) with no context given; a candidate could reasonably argue BAB's alpha is the stronger, so it is not safely judgeable standalone.

Conjunction of two dated, regulation-specific claims (FINRA uncapped CUSIP volumes with a six-month delay, 'as of 2025', and a MiFID II realized-cost reporting requirement); the MiFID II wording is loose and the card cannot be judged cleanly standalone.
